arxiv-2108-06527.title: Evolution Toward 6G Wireless Networks: A Resource Management Perspective
arxiv-2108-06527.creator: Mehdi Rasti, Shiva Kazemi Taskou, Hina Tabassum, Ekram Hossain
arxiv-2108-06527.description: Abstract In this article, we first present the vision, key performance indicators, key enabling techniques (KETs), and services of 6G wireless networks. Then, we highlight a series of general resource management (RM) challenges as well as unique RM challenges corresponding to each KET.

arxiv-2110-04650.title: Applications of the Tarski-Kantorovitch \br Fixed-Point Principle to the study of \br Infinite Iterated Function Systems
arxiv-2110-04650.creator: Bogdan-Alexandru Luchian
arxiv-2110-04650.description: Abstract . The aim of this paper is to establish some results regarding Infinite Iterated Function Systems with the help of the Tarski-Kantorovitch fixed-point principles for maps on partially ordered sets. To this end we introduce two new classes of Infinite Iterated Function Systems which are well suited for applying the aforementioned principle.

arxiv-2203-10829.title: Existence and Uniqueness of the Solution to the Anisotropic Quasi-Geostrophic Equations in the Sobolev Space
arxiv-2203-10829.creator: Mustapha Amara, Jamel Benameur
arxiv-2203-10829.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mustapha Amara, Jamel Benameur. In this paper, we focus on the two-dimensional surface quasi-geostrophic equation with fractional horizontal dissipation and vertical thermal diffusion which represents a general case of the classical surface quasi-geostrophic equation.

arxiv-2303-01853.title: Recent data analysis to revisit the spin structure function of nucleon in Laplace space
arxiv-2303-01853.creator: Hoda Nematollahi 1 ID, Abolfazl Mirjalili 2 ID, Shahin Atashbar Tehrani 3 ID
arxiv-2303-01853.description: Abstract Considering a fixed-flavor number scheme and based on laplace transdormation, we perform a leading-order and next-to-leading-order QCD analysis which are including world data on polarized structure functions g 1 g_{1} and g 2 g_{2} . During our analysis, taking the DGLAP evolution, we employ the Jacobi polynomials expansion technique.

arxiv-2506-09461.title: Holographic D-brane constructions with dynamical gauge fields
arxiv-2506-09461.creator: Yongjun Ahn, Matteo Baggioli, Hyun-Sik Jeong, Masataka Matsumoto
arxiv-2506-09461.description: Abstract Holographic D-brane constructions, governed by the Dirac-Born-Infeld (DBI) action, play a central role in the AdS/CFT correspondence, particularly in applications to quantum chromodynamics and condensed matter systems. In this work, we demonstrate how to equip these bottom-up holographic models with dynamical boundary gauge fields, thereby introducing electromagnetic interactions into their dual field theory descriptions.

pmc-12562709.title: “It’s Not Healthy to Be Too Large”—A Qualitative Study Using Participatory Methods to Explore Children’s and Adolescents’ Perspectives on Obesity Treatment and Body Image
pmc-12562709.creator: Tove Langlo Drilen, Trine Tetlie Eik-Nes, Rønnaug Astri Ødegård, Ellen Margrete Iveland Ersfjord
pmc-12562709.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Qualitative child-centered research on pediatric obesity treatment and body image remains limited. This study aimed to explore children’s and adolescents’ experiences with hospital-based obesity treatment and how these experiences relate to body image. Methods: A full-day workshop including three main participatory tasks was conducted in two groups of children (9–13 years) and adolescents (14–18 years), focusing on their experiences with obesity treatment and body image. Data were audiotaped, transcribed verbatim, and analyzed using reflexive thematic analysis.
